sources.entry: Folo 🧡 Next generation information browser. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/RSSNext/Folo) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Folo is an open-source AI RSS reader that gathers blogs, news, newsletters, podcasts, videos and social feeds into one timeline with AI summaries, translation and Q&A.
summary.what_it_does: Folo collects subscriptions from RSS, Atom and JSON feeds, plus RSSHub routes for sites without feeds, into a single timeline. It offers an AI assistant ("Folo AI") that can answer questions about an article, feed, folder or everything you follow, with a choice of models or your own API key and optional MCP service connections. It produces timeline digests, on-demand or automatic article summaries, and side-by-side AI translations into English, Chinese, Japanese or French. Scheduled AI tasks can generate daily or weekly briefings and send them to chat or email. It also supports text-to-speech, OPML import/export, an email inbox for newsletters, and integrations that send articles to services such as Obsidian, Readwise, Instapaper, Zotero, Cubox, Outline, Readeck and Eagle.
use_cases: Read news and blogs in one timeline
Get a daily AI digest of new articles
Summarize or translate articles with AI
Follow newsletters and podcasts in one app
Send saved articles to Obsidian, Readwise or Zotero
Migrate subscriptions from another reader via OPML
how_to_run: Use the hosted web app, or download the native app for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows or Linux from the README's platform table
Linux with Flatpak: install Folo from FlatPark (community maintained)
Nix: install the folo package (community maintained)
macOS with Homebrew: brew install the folo cask (community maintained)
Windows with Scoop: install the folo manifest (community maintained)
notable: AI assistant that can answer questions across an article, feed, folder or all subscriptions, with bring-your-own API key
Integrations with many read-later and note tools, plus rule-based Actions to filter, star, rewrite or summarize entries
Syncs subscriptions, read status and stars across web and native apps
Code signing via SignPath for Windows and Apple notarization for macOS and iOS
caveats: Under active development, so issues may occur
Some AI features depend on chosen models or a user-supplied API key
Icons in icons/mgc directory may not be redistributed under the license exception
